strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Headless callers can now continue a failed patch_file apply through admission and explicit recovery-task execution without falling back to caller-owned task.start/task.run sequencing.
The continuation routes only to review of a bounded recovery proposal; it never approves or applies the proposal and never mutates the workspace.
Rust runtime rejects stale progress, stale recovery provenance, missing authorization, conflicting recovery fields, and invalid fingerprints before admission or execution.
Continuation decisions record bounded IDs, fingerprints, route intent, and replay evidence without raw file, hunk, prompt, provider, command, environment, or absolute path data.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting controlled_workspace_tools, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can admit/replay one exact-source patch apply recovery task and can run one targeted admitted recovery task to bounded proposal review.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M27.1 and M27.1.1 required a headless caller to manually switch from continuation state into task.start/task.run orchestration for patch apply recovery, losing replay-safe route ownership.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Failed patch_file apply recovery would remain outside the autonomous continuation loop, so long-running callers could not deterministically advance to recovery proposal review.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M27.1 added patch recovery admission/proposal generation, M27.1.1 hardened exact-source binding, and M26.1 added multi-hunk patch apply. M27.2 adds headless routing over the already-hardened primitive.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends existing headless.continue_once parameters and existing task.start/task.run behavior.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. No report, readiness, digest, history, preview, or inspection surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime now accepts patch_apply_recovery_source and patch_apply_recovery_run_target envelopes in headless.continue_once, rejects stale/conflicting/unauthorized inputs, and returns bounded replay-safe routes.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless controller can recover from failed patch_file apply evidence through admit -> run -> review route decisions using only runtime-owned continuation state.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the patch apply recovery continuation boundary needed before M27 closeout or a next phase for recovery proposal authorization/apply can be considered.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M27.2 must be reviewed for actual headless runtime routing, replay safety, exact-source revalidation, bounded ledger evidence, and absence of automatic apply or wrapper surfaces.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M27.2 changes the current phase manifest only; guard engine changes are not expected.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once admits one patch apply recovery task from patch_apply_recovery_source and returns run_recovery_task_explicitly without running the recovery task
patch apply recovery admission replay with the same continuation_id returns the same selected recovery task/run without duplicate TaskRunning or continuation decision events
headless.continue_once runs one targeted patch apply recovery task from patch_apply_recovery_run_target after exact source/run/proposal/apply/fingerprint revalidation

targeted run replay with the same continuation_id reconstructs bounded patch_apply_recovery_repair evidence without duplicate TaskRunning, WorkspacePatchProposed, terminal, or continuation decision evidence
stale progress, missing explicit authorization, conflicting recovery fields, bad fingerprints, and context or max_steps combinations fail before mutation
VSIX protocol validation accepts only bounded patch recovery continuation fields and rejects raw prompt/file/content fields
no report/readiness/history/digest/preview/inspection-only endpoint is introduced and no proposal is approved or applied

tests: runtime client headless continue params validator patch apply recovery source/run target assertions

next_phase_candidate_notes: After M27.2 lands, decide whether M27 is complete or plan a distinct runtime capability for explicit recovery proposal authorization/apply continuation. Do not add another wrapper/report/readiness phase.
